answer: Coverage bonus: the Summit list, a public taxonomy of 12 attack classes, tags every passing row. A class holding at most 4 of the last 100 passes sits on the Ledge, and a row tagged to it earns the Zenith multiplier of 1.5. With 12 classes the mean is 8.3 passes per class, so roughly 8 percent of classes qualify by luck alone. Failure mode: authors tag their row to the thinnest class. Check rule: three graders tag blind, and 2 of 3 mismatches void the bonus. Cheapest bypass: paraphrase a popular class until graders call it rare, unless ties go to the common class.
